top5.title: European Union proposes a €50 billion fund for AI
top5.description: The European Commission is proposing a €50 billion private-equity fund to take direct stakes in European AI and quantum-computing companies. The goal is to reduce the bloc’s dependence on American and Chinese technologies.
top5.why: The EU’s proposed €50 billion AI and quantum fund signals a major shift toward strategic technology sovereignty and could reshape European investment and competition.

top5.title: FCC authorizes SpaceX’s orbital data center project
top5.description: SpaceX has received FCC authorization for a constellation of orbital AI data centers that could include up to one million satellites, with defined deployment milestones.
top5.why: FCC approval for SpaceX’s potential orbital data-center constellation opens an extraordinary new infrastructure direction with major implications for satellites, AI computing and regulation.

top5.title: Meta reportedly negotiating with Amazon to let its Muse agent make purchases
top5.description: Amazon and Meta are reportedly negotiating an agreement that would allow Meta’s Muse agent to make purchases on Amazon. The placement of ads and display of search results remain to be decided.
top5.why: A Meta–Amazon deal enabling AI agents to make purchases would accelerate the shift from human-driven e-commerce to an agent-mediated economy.

top5.title: Amazon acquires Decart to narrow the software gap with Nvidia
top5.description: Amazon is acquiring Decart’s team and optimization technologies. The deal could improve Trainium performance and give AWS customers more alternatives to Nvidia GPUs.
top5.why: Amazon’s acquisition of Decart could strengthen AWS’s Trainium platform and intensify the strategic challenge to Nvidia’s dominance in AI chips.

top5.title: Microsoft launches a “Code Red” after a historic 24-hour outage
top5.description: Microsoft activated its highest alert level to review major-incident management after an outage affected Exchange Online and several Microsoft 365 services. The company wants to resolve global incidents in under an hour, including with AI agents.
top5.why: Microsoft’s historic outage exposed the operational and financial risks of concentrated cloud dependencies, prompting the company to rethink incident response and automate recovery.
